execution_gate: No launch until separate manifests, code hash, approved resource budget and acceptance protocol are frozen
old_t05_results: immutable; never replace retrospective metrics or select old Test checkpoints

stage_a.purpose: development-only within-checkpoint intervention before any retraining
stage_a.development_tapes: D-02 bank, explicitly already viewed development data
stage_a.interpretation: Effect of disabling an existing trained adapter in simulation; NOT a separately trained no-WM baseline

train_validation_test.train: fresh recorded reset/instance/event namespaces, full manifests frozen before launch
train_validation_test.test_seal: generated and hash-sealed before training; no result inspection until all fixed runs finish

stage_b_proposed.primary_metric: all_decision_return: sum of actual accepted-decision rewards, aligned to PPO training reward
stage_b_proposed.rationale: Prospective dual reporting after discovering baseline aggregation semantics; does not change T-05 conclusion

proposed_acceptance.return: EAWM vs independent GPPO paired hierarchical bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0, and positive mean difference in at least 4 of 5 seeds
proposed_acceptance.bootstrap: resample training seeds and paired tape identities hierarchically; 10000 draws; never treat all episodes as independent seeds
proposed_acceptance.fixed_j: upper 95% bound of paired cost difference <= 0
proposed_acceptance.final_infeasible_rate: upper 95% bound of absolute rate difference <= 0.005 (0.5 percentage point)
proposed_acceptance.failure_policy: publish all results and reject improvement claim; no test-driven checkpoint or seed selection

unresolved_before_launch: exact seed namespaces and dataset manifests
validation-only tuning allowance and its cap

t06: not started; consider only after independent evidence justifies additional model-based planning
